meta.name: Regent
meta.description: Brand design tokens for Tung Anh Tran: deep regent green on a cool pearl ground, with one thread of antique gold. Type is Libre Bodoni for display (a sturdy Didone) and Jost for text. Single source of truth for colour, type and spacing.

primary.name: Regent green
primary.usage: Headings, primary data series, the signature, filled buttons

faint.name: Haze
faint.usage: Faint labels, dashed placeholder outlines; too light for body text

accent.name: Antique gold
accent.usage: The one 'look here' per view: a thin gilt rule over the headline metric, a highlighted data point, the active section. Never a regular data series and never body text. Text on a gold fill is deep, large or bold only

secondary.name: Bottle green
secondary.usage: Links, active navigation, the second data tone. Not a fill behind text

sunken.name: Mist
sunken.usage: Sunken or alternating sections, inline code

deep.name: Forest
deep.usage: Hero, contact band and footer; tooltips

on-deep.name: Pearl on deep
on-deep.usage: Text and fine engraving lines on Forest bands

glint.name: Gilt
glint.usage: The one highlight on Forest bands: an engraving strand, a focus ring, an italic line
